Imagine being a researcher trying to understand the inner workings of a complex neural network, a question that has puzzled many in the field of AI and ML. Researchers are working to open up neural networks and understand their decision-making processes. This involves finding a global workspace and using mechanistic interpretability to break down the network into its individual components.
